objective: Correct two settings of the Pi tool surface (commit 0a89801 on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-tools, worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-tools) to the maintainer's decisions.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-tools; gates bunx --no-install mise run verify and bunx --no-install mise run build.

1. Codemode: the brief said codemode for the root only, which was wrong. The maintainer decided (Intent 0.3.0 pi 4/10, recorded in docs/pi/orchestration.md): codemode runs in mode "only" for the root and every specialist; tools registered model-only (such as rpiv-ask-user-question) stay directly callable; PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS is 4. Make toolArgs give +codemode (or the codemode setting that yields mode only) to every role and the root, keep each role's allowlist otherwise as it is, export the PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS value for the launcher, and restore docs/pi/configuration.md to say root and every specialist. Tests per role.

2. Billion Context: the decided behavior is compression on for root and specialist sessions with Billion Context's own acp_delegate subagents off. The pair written now (pi.subagents:false in billion-context.json and delegate.forceEnable:true in ~/.pi/acp.json) may contradict itself per its docs. Read the 'Pi built-in subagents' section of /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/readmes/billion-context.md (and any other section it links in that file) and provide exactly the settings it gives for disabling the built-in subagents while keeping context compression; drop any setting the README says is ignored or only matters with acp_delegate on. Cite the README lines in a code comment and in docs/pi/extensions.md, and remove the 'to be verified' flag once settled; if the README does not settle it, say so in the report and keep the flag.
constraints: Fixtures only; no pi binary, no network.
Keep the Claude generated output unchanged apart from rebuilt bundles.
Make no version-control writes; report changed paths.
Report in under 300 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text (no backticks), a colon, then the support.

criteria.text: Every role and the root run codemode in mode only with PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS 4 exported, and the docs say so, with tests
The Billion Context settings are exactly those the README gives for compression on with its subagents off, cited
bunx --no-install mise run verify exits 0 and mise run build leaves generated output in sync
